# axm docs install

Install docs packages

## When to use

Install docs packages

## Usage

```bash
axm docs install [flags] [<source>]
```

## Arguments

| Name     | Type   | Required | Description                                                         |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source` | string | No       | docs package source (@owner/docs/name, path, URL, or git shorthand) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Install to project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip confirmation after reviewing the install plan                                |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Reinstall even if the docs package already exists                                 |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be installed without making changes                               |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Reinstall configured docs packages**

```bash
axm docs install
```

**Install a docs package from the registry**

```bash
axm docs install @acme/docs/workspace-baseline
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
